status: M3 independent backend, seeded persistence and desktop workflow verified; final repository delivery, Qoder UID and competition submission pending

core_scenarios.requirement: Save project decisions and next actions through real PowerContext, restart services, resume in a fresh browser session, and verify exact content and references.
Create two projects with conflicting decisions; recovery, search and reports must only use the selected project's context.
Revise a decision; current recovery uses the new revision while the previous revision remains traceable.
Every reported decision or progress item links to a readable original record; user-provided URLs are not treated as independently verified sources.
Save a handoff, open a new session, recover unfinished work and mark an action complete; a subsequent handoff reflects that state.
When PowerContext is unavailable, the UI reports failure and does not claim that unsaved data is persisted.
Export readable Markdown with project scope, reporting period, completed work, pending work, decisions and source references.
Document and exercise installation/startup and a complete seeded scenario from an empty application data directory.

delivery_gates: Code descends from official 2026-competition-ecosystem and project assets live under qoder/.
Primary implementation and fixes are performed in Qoder with retained visible development records and account UID.
Qoder Sites project website is published and accessible without login.
Website includes problem, functions, actual demo images or video, repository link and reproduction instructions.
Repository and fixed commit are accessible to the evaluator.
Competition submission includes website, repository, Qoder UID, runbook, verification fixtures and development evidence.
measurement_policy: Synthetic example data is labeled as such. Measured timings describe the actual measured task and machine. No invented user counts, feedback or productivity claims.

blocking_findings: Hidden dialogs and drawer render over the initial page
Acknowledgement silently accepts an unseen latest handoff revision
Resolved/done/dropped items appear actionable during restore
independent_review.disposition: M2 corrective task sent to Qoder; no final acceptance or publication claimed

limitations: File download not independently verified; clipboard export verified
